match.userMessage: Storyboard animatic frame. medium wide. eye level. Scarlett and Mina lean along the low concrete wall on opposite thirds, peach skyline and distant train layered behind them. Scarlett and Mina lean against the rooftop wall at sunset, with the coral lipstick still in Mina’s pocket and wind lifting their hair. Then: Mina pulls out the lipstick, applies one final swipe, and turns toward Scarlett. Camera: orbit, smooth. Characters: Scarlett: Woman, 27, A 27-year-old woman of average height with a slim, active build, warm medium skin, expressive dark eyes, and dark brown hair worn loose to the shoulders. Her face is youthful, with defined brows and a quick, open smile. Her appearance becomes visibly brighter as the coral lipstick brings color to her complexion, wearing Black fitted turtleneck, black wool coat carried or worn. Mina: Woman, Late 20s, A woman in her late 20s with an average height and softly angular features, tired eyes, and expressive brows. Her hair is medium-to-dark brown, shoulder length, and easily lifted by the rooftop wind. Her face visibly transforms from exhausted to amused after applying the lipstick, wearing Green utility jacket with a roomy pocket, simple dark top, dark trousers or jeans, and. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, correct perspective and depth, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Figures have readable poses, gestures and simple expressive faces. Draw the single opening moment of the shot: each character appears exactly once, and what happens next is shown only by a few bold arrows for the camera move and the way subjects travel. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels.
